bugs.error_message: Contract suite expected order would fail a correct store that keeps microsecond timestamps (sub-microsecond pair tied in the store, ordered by tie-breaker, but the oracle compared full ticks)
bugs.root_cause: ContractOrder.Sort compared CreatedAt at tick precision, i.e. the in-memory store's semantics, not the store under test.
bugs.fix: IPageSourceFixture.TimestampPrecision (default 1 microsecond); the oracle compares timestamps at it. In-memory fixture declares one tick. MyStoreContractTests (README skeleton) runs the suite over a microsecond store.

bugs.error_message: Testing with VSTest target is no longer supported by Microsoft.Testing.Platform on .NET 10 SDK
bugs.root_cause: xunit.v3 runs on Microsoft.Testing.Platform; .NET 10 dotnet test defaults to VSTest.
bugs.fix: global.json test.runner = Microsoft.Testing.Platform; drop Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk and xunit.runner.visualstudio from the test project.
